# VeltraUI Documentation & Architecture Reference
> Ultra-lightweight, Enterprise-grade Admin UI Suite built with pure Tailwind CSS v4 and Vanilla TypeScript.

## Quick Links
- Official Website: https://veltra-ui.stivensespinoza.dev
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/stivens19/veltra-ui
- Full Documentation: https://veltra-ui.stivensespinoza.dev/docs.html
- Live Dashboard: https://veltra-ui.stivensespinoza.dev/dashboard1.html

## AI & Developer Resources
- AI Skill Reference (Markdown): https://veltra-ui.stivensespinoza.dev/ai/veltra-ai-skill.md
- Full 39-Template Context (Markdown): https://veltra-ui.stivensespinoza.dev/ai/veltra-context.md
- Downloadable Bundle (ZIP): https://veltra-ui.stivensespinoza.dev/veltra-ui.zip

## Key Features
- Pure Tailwind CSS v4 (@import "tailwindcss"; native, zero tailwind.config.js)
- Zero heavy dependencies (no jQuery, no legacy preprocessors)
- Persistent Anti-FOUC Dark Mode (localStorage + head script)
- 39 Ready-to-use HTML Templates
- Framework-agnostic: Works natively in HTML, Laravel Blade (<x-ui.*>), React, Next.js, Vue, and Angular.
